description: CW-A, the customer load job (CW plan §4): every refusal row, the identity read, the control origin, the toolchain hashes, the lockfile URL and SRI checks, the verified download (its first-failure stop and its retries), the refusal causes the job prints (fixed reasons and checked identifiers, one a line), the download total and idle limit, the platform skip, the best-effort summary, the typed checkout_changed and startup_failed details, journey failures and the Playwright check as closed-set codes, the one stream formatter, and the supervisor's toolchain-first startup. A survivor means a security check no test would notice losing. Not here: the `%` check in canonicalRegistryTarball, an equivalent mutant (TARBALL_PATH admits no `%` either, so dropping it changes no answer; it stays as a second guard).
